title: peer_node misleading name in SSE stall log: always owner not peer
description: The variable is named peer_node (events.rs:317) but SSE is owner-only (auth check at line 137 ensures Role::Owner before the code runs). In Kith, 'peer' is a term-of-art for another kith user delivering messages; using it here for the SSE client (always the owner) will mislead a future contributor reading the warn log or the code. They may ask 'why does the warn log say peer= for an owner-only endpoint?' A more accurate name would be client_node or owner_node, and the log field key should match.
